title: Punishment Divine
description: Gain the **Invoke the Divine** Cleric Starting Move if you don't already have it, except your deity's Domain is War. Choose your deity's worshippers and enemies as detailed in the Move.

outcomes.text: Add War to your deity's domains. Is this a new aspect of your deity, a result of your unique connection to them, or something else?

submoves.title: Divine Shield
submoves.description: Once per scene, when you take dmg, you may erase 1 Depth with your deity to ignore it, even if it is **piercing**.

submoves.title: Rebuke
submoves.description: Once per session, when you condemn someone for their evil ways, gain 1 Depth with your deity.

title: Spiritual Weapon
description: When you **shout your deity's name like a battle cry**, their power fills any weapon you wield until the end of the scene. Choose one blessing below, or erase 1 Depth with your deity to choose two.

bullets: Add +1 to all dmg it deals
It #pierces the armor of your deity's enemies
It can hover and fight on its own as an extension of your will; treat it as a loyal NPC, when it takes dmg it loses this benefit unless you feed it your lifeforce to continue (lose 1 HP)

outcomes.text: When you **Face Death**, you also have access to the following option:
bullets: *Divine Intervention*. Your deity miraculously saves your life, banishes a danger, enemy or obstacle, then restores all your HP. You're no longer helpless. You still **lock** a Condition after Facing Death.

title: Drink From the Cup of Wrath
description: When you **condemn someone for their evil ways**, instead of gaining 1 Depth with your deity, you may make the condemned an enemy of your deity (if they aren't already).

outcomes.text: When you **petition your deity to harm or curse a collective enemy** (e.g. a faction, creature type, inhabitants of a location, etc.), treat it as **Perform a Ritual**, but after the GM tells you the requirements you may erase Depth with your deity, 1-for-1, to miraculously fulfill them.

title: Divine Intuition
description: When you **first encounter an enemy of your deity**, you may ask the GM questions about it equal to your wis. You get **adv** on your first roll related to the answer(s).
